import trimesh, numpy as np
h = trimesh.load('exports/model.hanger.bb97b27d.stl')

def ray_oo(pt, d):
    loc, rid, _ = h.ray.intersects_location(np.array([pt], float), np.array([d], float), multiple_hits=True)
    if len(loc) == 0: return []
    proj = (loc - np.array(pt, float)) @ np.array(d, float)
    return [round(float(v), 3) for v in sorted(proj)]

tests = [
    ('tenon X width: from (20,10,17) dir -x -> expect segment 24 (4..28)', [20,10,17], [-1,0,0]),
    ('tenon Z depth: from (0,10,50) dir -z -> expect 34 (16..50)', [0,10,50], [0,0,-1]),
    ('crown flat: from (0,41.45,50) dir -z -> expect 30 (18..48)', [0,41.45,50], [0,0,-1]),
    ('full width at x=40: from (40,35,50) dir -z -> expect 34', [40,35,50], [0,0,-1]),
]
for name, pt, d in tests:
    print(name, 'rays at:', ray_oo(pt, d))
